canonical_shortcut.rival: Use monochrome 4-connectivity before filling each object's bounding box.
canonical_shortcut.rival_program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (foldl
    (lambda (obj acc)
      (let ((bb (obj-bbox obj)))
        (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
          (lambda (r c)
            (if (and (>= r (first bb)) (<= r (third bb))
                     (>= c (second bb)) (<= c (fourth bb))
                     (= (at acc r c) 0))
                7 (at acc r c))))))
    g (objects g 0))))

limits: Canonical shortcut evidence covers exactly two supplied train pairs and one supplied canonical test pair. Public-focus evidence checks a candidate on the two supplied demonstrations only; it does not establish the evaluation test answer, complete task semantics, verified ancestry, or training admission.

public_focus.candidate: On background 8, extract same-color 8-connected objects; project to u=r+c and v=r-c; fill background with 2 strictly between ordered u intervals and within their intersected v intervals. No own-object bbox fill.
public_focus.candidate_program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let ((projected
    (map (lambda (obj)
      (let* ((cells (obj-cells obj))
             (us (map (lambda (p) (+ (first p) (second p))) cells))
             (vs (map (lambda (p) (- (first p) (second p))) cells)))
        (list (apply min us) (apply max us) (apply min vs) (apply max vs))))
      (objects-8 g 8))))
    (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
      (lambda (r c)
        (let ((u (+ r c)) (v (- r c)))
          (if (and (= (at g r c) 8)
                   (for/or ((a (in-list projected)))
                     (for/or ((b (in-list projected)))
                       (and (< (second a) (first b))
                            (< (second a) u) (< u (first b))
                            (<= (max (third a) (third b)) v)
                            (<= v (min (fourth a) (fourth b)))))))
              2 (at g r c))))))))
public_focus.transferred_idea: Complete gaps between input-derived diagonal object projections. The native extension uses this bridge after ordinary bbox completion, with background 0 and fill 7, so it is not the same transformation as this focus candidate.
